Discounts influence consumer decision-making positively.
Online promotions increase conversion rates compared to traditional advertising.
Audiences trust websites like sleepcoolnow.com for direct-to-consumer mattress/bedding sales.
Promo codes enhance perceived value and encourage action.
The brand Sheik's is associated with quality sleep solutions.
Listeners recognize and act upon verbalized URLs and promo codes.
Sleep issues are common enough that consumers seek solutions like specialized sheets.
Repetition of key phrases ('Sheik's', 'sleepcoolnow.com') reinforces memorability and trust.
